workstreams.name: Spanish market and channels
workstreams.answers: How large and attractive is the Spanish retail market for Quinta Azul's olive oil, and which channels reach it?
activities: Size Spanish retail demand and growth from market data
Assess channel listing terms, margins and shelf access
Review regulation for selling olive oil in Spain

workstreams.name: Competitor landscape
workstreams.answers: Who competes for Spanish retail shelf space in olive oil, and how do they position their products?
activities: Profile competing olive-oil brands on Spanish shelves
Compare ranges, prices and positioning from store visits
Write up competitor profiles for the steering workshop

workstreams.name: Buyer and shopper needs
workstreams.answers: What do Spanish retail buyers and shoppers need from an olive-oil supplier?
activities: Interview retail buyers on listing criteria and needs
Sample shopper segments by survey or in-store interviews
Write up buyer and shopper findings by channel

workstreams.name: Capability to win in Spain
workstreams.answers: Does Quinta Azul have the assets and capabilities to win in Spanish retail?
activities: Interview staff who run Quinta Azul's operations
Review operational data on capacity and cost to serve
Assess gaps between Quinta Azul's assets and buyer needs

workstreams.name: Entry option business case
workstreams.answers: Which entry options exist for Spain, and does the business case support a go or no-go?
activities: Compare entry options for Spain on agreed criteria
Build the business case from the Research findings
Test cost and margin assumptions against operational data

workstreams.name: Entry plan and roadmap
workstreams.answers: If the answer is go, what entry plan and roadmap should Quinta Azul follow?
activities: Sequence the steps of an entry plan for Spain
Draft the entry roadmap for the chosen option
Review the draft plan with the CEO and Commercial Director
